hero.title: Welcome to Dawar Kitchen
hero.subtitle: Delivering all around Cairo. Fresh, home-style meals prepared with love by Syrian and Egyptian women. A social enterprise celebrating food heritage and fair work.

about.recipesDesc: Authentic Syrian and Egyptian recipes passed down through generations, prepared with love and expertise
about.ingredientsDesc: We source the finest and freshest ingredients from local suppliers to ensure quality in every dish
about.fairWorkDesc: Every meal supports fair wages and dignified employment for Syrian and Egyptian women
about.supportMessage: Order from Dawar Kitchen and enjoy authentic cuisine while supporting fair work and food heritage
about.aboutDesc: Dawar Kitchen is a social enterprise located in Ezbet Khairallah, Cairo. Through catering and food production, we provide dignified employment and vocational training for Syrian, refugee, and Egyptian women.

chefs.heading: Meet Our Chefs
chefs.description: Decades of experience from the historic kitchens of Cairo and Alexandria, brought to life on every plate.
